purpose: Teach: モト/ごとき/にたいして/ウォーク/驚愕/ダース/貴女/だけれども

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんのモトクラスメイトに会えるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, you get to meet your dad's old classmate today.
lines.style: Light, warm delivery. A small smile in the voice. Matter-of-fact but gentle—sharing something nice she knows he'll enjoy.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼくごときでもお父さんは可愛がって下さるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, even someone like me—Dad's always kind to me, isn't he?
lines.style: Soft, uncertain. A small boy testing an idea out loud. The careful politeness of a child who has been made to feel small elsewhere.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お友達にたいして思いやりを忘れずにね
lines.en: Sho, remember to be thoughtful with your friends too, all right?
lines.style: Gentle guidance, not instruction. A slight lift at the end—checking in rather than directing. Warm but serious underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さんと朝ウォークしたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I went on a morning walk with Dad!
lines.style: Bright, immediate. The bubbling-up of genuine excitement. A small child who has just done something special and needs to tell someone about it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんのプレゼントに驚愕したわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad really gave you quite a surprise with his present.
lines.style: Warm delight in her voice. A slight laugh underneath—charmed by whatever he received, charmed by him. Approving.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに鉛筆をダース箱で頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad gave me a whole dozen box of pencils!
lines.style: Quick, eager delivery. The slight breathlessness of a six-year-old proud of his gift. Clear wonder that something so practical feels so generous to him.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんも「貴女が大切」って言われたよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad told me something too—that you're very important to him.
lines.style: Quiet, tender. Slow pace. She's giving him something precious and fragile. Letting the words land. A slight catch of emotion, carefully controlled.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お腹空いただけれども宿題終わらせるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm hungry, but I'll finish my homework first.
lines.style: Determined whisper. A child marshalling his own discipline. Small and earnest and trying hard. No complaint in it—just the quiet resolve of someone young working through what matters.
